correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the Fourier decomposition and positive generalized Gram forms H_m(s)_{ij}=s^{m+i+j+1}/(m+i+j+1). H_m(s)=s^{m+1}D_s H_m(1) D_s proves exact determinant ratio s^{q(m+q)}. Normalized t^m weight concentrates at t=1; y=m(1-t) has moments converging to h!, so orthogonal basis tends coefficientwise to normalized Laguerre polynomials. The dilation C_s becomes y->m(1-s)+sy; its upper triangular entries have leading powers a^{j-i} s^i/(j-i)!. Exterior kth minors have unique highest a-degree k(q-k), reciprocal-factorial Vandermonde determinant yields product top k singular values and successive factorial constants. Eigenvalue ratios tend to s, allowing counting by thresholds; the coefficients sum to zero, with finitely many negative angular sectors. Independently checked 24 exact rational generalized-Gram determinants and high-precision asymptotic ratios for q=3,4 and m=250,500; finite checks only corroborate the proof for m->infinity.
